scientific_limitations: The service rate is known, arrivals are homogeneous Poisson, and the comparison uses only unlabelled within-busy observations, not idle intervals or customer provenance.
The finite optimal testing-risk formula is an absolutely convergent infinite series whose numerical truncation may be slow near critical traffic.
A 1961 joint-law original and a 2020 predecessor could not be inspected in full, leaving historical priority risk.

Path sufficiency for stopped M/M/1 trajectories follows classical likelihood theory (Clarke 1957), so it is not asserted as an independent novelty; the claimed research addition is the exact paired finite decision law and covert information constant.
title: Exact paired busy-period detection law and sharp covert constant
